detection.ground_truth: tight exclusive xyxy of each resized ground-truth instance ID, ordered by ID
detection.predictor: 4-connected components of model foreground argmax, minimum 16 pixels; score mean foreground softmax probability; tight exclusive xyxy; never uses GT
detection.qualification: derived-mask proposal baseline only; does not qualify an independent detection model or full detection recipe

reference: Independent Python/Pillow/NumPy preprocessing, counts, connected components and pycocotools bbox AP from C++ predictions; no reference model predictions generated from GT.

segmentation.input: FP32 RGB /255; bilinear antialias resize to128x128; mask nearest-exact, any instance>0 becomes person

training.model: Tiny U-Net 8/16/32 channels, no BatchNorm, two 3x3 convolutions per level; random initialization; no pretrained weights
training.selection: final epoch only; validation/test do not select model or hyperparameters
